description: This Java source file defines the TypeUtils class, which provides utility methods for type conversions, class name manipulations, and package handling within the Android APK checking tool.

classes.name: TypeUtils
classes.description: Utility class for handling Java type descriptors, class name conversions, and package analysis.

methods.name: typeToDescriptor
methods.description: Converts a human-readable Java type into its descriptor form used in method signatures.

methods.name: simpleClassNameToBinary
methods.description: Converts a simple class name to its binary form by replacing dots with dollar signs.

methods.name: classNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the class name from a fully-qualified binary class name.

methods.name: packageNameOnly
methods.description: Extracts the package name from a fully-qualified binary class name.

methods.name: ambiguousToBinaryName
methods.description: Normalizes a class name to binary form, resolving package ambiguities and handling nested classes.
